visual.name: smartVisualsDataFreshness
visual.description: Free data freshness badge for Power BI. Shows every reader when the data was refreshed, in their own time zone, and what period it covers, with the last refresh status, fresh, ageing and stale states per source, business-time thresholds (working days and hours), the expected refresh schedule and the absolute time printed next to every relative age. Part of the SmartVisuals visual family.

dataRoles.name: refreshed
dataRoles.description: When the data was last refreshed. Recipe: a one-row Power Query table with DateTimeZone.RemoveZone(DateTimeZone.UtcNow()), then MAX of it. Read as UTC by default (Time Zones card).

dataRoles.name: through
dataRoles.description: The last date the data covers, e.g. CALCULATE(MAX(Sales[Order Date]), REMOVEFILTERS()). Tested against the expected lag.

dataRoles.name: source
dataRoles.description: Optional: one row per source or table (a load log, dataflows). Shows a list with a state per source.

dataRoles.name: detail
dataRoles.description: Optional text under each source name: owner, system, schedule.

dataRoles.name: status
dataRoles.description: Optional: the outcome of the last refresh run, as text (Succeeded, Failed, Cancelled) or a numeric code (Last Status card). Shown next to the refresh time; a failed run marks the source stale by default.

dataRoles.name: next
dataRoles.description: Optional: the next scheduled refresh, when your data knows it. Wins over the Refresh Schedule card.

dataRoles.name: ageingAfter
dataRoles.description: Optional per-source threshold from your data; wins over the format pane.

dataRoles.name: staleAfter
dataRoles.description: Optional per-source threshold from your data; wins over the format pane.

dataRoles.name: tooltips
dataRoles.description: Extra measures shown in the tooltip.
